NAME:
   forecast-ledger forecast show - Show a forecast

USAGE:
   forecast-ledger forecast show [options]

DESCRIPTION:
   Example:
     forecast-ledger forecast show --file ledger.yaml --question q-launch --forecast f-001

   Normal human and plain output includes type-aware public values and safe stored integrity evidence; sealed private fields stay redacted. No network check is performed.

OPTIONS:
   --file string, -f string  Ledger file path; use - for ledger bytes on stdin (sibling artifacts are unavailable)
   --question string         Stable question ID
   --forecast string         Stable forecast ID
   --help, -h                show help

GLOBAL OPTIONS:
   --json              Write stable JSON output
   --plain             Write plain text without decoration
   --quiet, -q         Suppress successful output
   --verbose, -v       Write additional diagnostics to stderr
   --no-color          Disable color and interactive decoration
   --no-input          Never prompt; fail when input is missing
   --yes, -y           Approve a change that requires confirmation
   --timeout duration  Limit operation work; ledger lock conflicts remain immediate (default: 30s)
